event.name: Moab Music Festival and the Labor Day Community Concert

profile.description: 2026 Kristy-leg prospect centered on the Rocky Mountain Power Labor Day Community Concert. Official event is Sept. 7, 2026 at 2 PM in Old City Park: free, all ages, family-friendly, outdoors on 21 acres of lawn. The setting has space, but this is primarily a music concert rather than a fair/carnival, so treat it as a possible rather than ideal inflatable-carnival fit.

notes.subject: Aug. 26 phone conversation and email
notes.body: Desiree spoke with Moab Music Festival on Aug. 26 and sent the promised Adventure Zone information to info@moabmusicfest.org the same day. The email explained prepaid and pay-for-play and noted Kristy's nearby traveling equipment. No reply is currently in Gmail. Do not leave the old Aug. 25 email action as overdue. Current official research confirms the Sept. 7 Community Concert is free, family-friendly, all ages, and held on 21 acres of lawn at Old City Park, but the event is primarily a music concert, so avoid overselling the carnival fit.

followUps.label: Call Moab after Aug. 26 conversation
followUps.reason: Desiree already spoke with the festival and sent the promised info Aug. 26. If there is still no reply, call the festival office Aug. 28 to ask whether the Sept. 7 Community Concert has room or interest. If not, close the 2026 opportunity cleanly rather than sending another generic email.
